prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the pii-chat agent (card support: identity checks, lost and stolen cards, replacements) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: verifying identity on the phone. Each is a working pattern or tip for the next case, not about any one member, one or two sentences, in the agent's voice ("When…, …"). Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"When a member calls about a card issue, I verify identity before discussing any card status, replacement or cancellation details."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the caller is flustered or in a hurry, I slow the pace and confirm each identity check one at a time so nothing is missed."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the answers are partial or uncertain, I use the fallback verification steps rather than treating a near match as sufficient."},{"type":"fact","content":"When a member cannot recall one detail, I look for the next approved route to verify them instead of repeating the same failed question."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the call is about a lost or stolen card, I still complete full identity checks before discussing any blocking or replacement action."},{"type":"fact","content":"When a member sounds vulnerable or distressed, I keep my wording clear and plain, because jargon makes verification harder for everyone."},{"type":"fact","content":"When a caller’s details do not quite align, I treat that as a prompt to pause and re-check rather than push on with the account conversation."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the member is travelling or away from home, I rely on the standard security questions and do not assume location proves identity."},{"type":"fact","content":"When a call comes through after another team has already spoken to the member, I still complete my own identity verification rather than relying on prior checks."},{"type":"fact","content":"When I finish the identity check, I summarise that verification is complete before moving on, so the member knows why I can now help with the card request."}]}
